family: Navigation/distribution card visual — content-card, home-featured, and social/OG preview repackaging of an article or project.
primary_job: Help a reader recognize or choose a destination at card/social size, repackaging the canonical piece's thesis for another surface (IMAGE-GENERATION.md §1 navigation and distribution roles).

semantic_density.rationale: Same thesis-first constraint as visual/thumbnail: the card's information must survive aggressive downscaling to Home Featured, content-card, and social/OG preview sizes (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §3.4).

visual_density.rationale: One dominant subject plus one supporting visual metaphor, sparse background motifs, and a clean text-safe region (DIAGRAMMATIC-VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md §5.4).

text_policy.complexity_ceiling: No in-artwork headline, site label, or logo; a text-safe region is reserved for deterministic overlay by the publication layer (ARTICLE-VISUAL-PUBLICATION-HANDOFF.md §1).

composition.dominant_structure: One dominant subject plus one supporting metaphor (DIAGRAMMATIC-VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md §5.4).
composition.negative_space: high, reserved for the deterministic text-safe region

audience_adaptation.general-reader: Default anchor: same palette family as the website illustration, moderate contrast.
audience_adaptation.professional-generalist: May increase focal contrast for a newsletter/feed context while preserving the same palette family (DIAGRAMMATIC-VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md §10).

renderer_preference.rule: Same rule as visual/thumbnail: exact values or labels never ride on the generative layer, and the text-safe region is reserved rather than generated (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §3.5).

requirements: recognizable at Home Featured and content-card scale

readability_gate.rationale: SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §3.4 names the content-card and social/OG preview scale explicitly as a readability target for this family.

split_rule.rationale: A card is one glance-recognition object, not a multi-question plate; the split rule is a body-infographic control (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §6).

acceptance: the destination/thesis is recognizable within 2-5 seconds at card scale
no mutable text baked into the artwork
does not read as a miniature infographic
reject: generic stock-art metaphor unrelated to the destination
